raw_text: Kotlin Multiplatform, object-oriented Vulkan 1.4 wrapper; handle types have RAII wrappers. Exceptions handle errors; context parameters scope memory. Aim for full API/extension coverage except deprecated or unsupported: render passes/framebuffers, custom allocators, raytracing. Uses kotlinx-datetime, kotlinx-io, volk, volk-kotlin; modules: vulkan-kotlin, sample. Targets modern desktop/mobile GPUs; minimum driver Vulkan 1.3. Supports `VK_KHR_dynamic_rendering`, `VK_KHR_dynamic_rendering_local_read`, `VK_EXT_extended_dynamic_state2`, `VK_KHR_synchronization2`. Sort class functions public then private, lexicographically. `Device` factories create most classes needing `VkDevice`. For native allocation, pass `NativePlacement` as context parameter; caller handles allocation/freeing. Prefer core over extension functionality. Every `public` class, function and property must have a KDoc. Run tests and static analysis: `./gradlew check`
